# Downtown Calgary Office Cleaning

> Nightly janitorial, sanitizing, and specialty office cleaning for offices in
> Downtown Calgary and surrounding areas. Insured & bonded. Flexible
> after-hours scheduling. Free quotes.

## Services

- Nightly Office Cleaning — after-hours janitorial cleaning
- Trash & Recycling Removal
- Kitchen & Breakroom Cleaning
- Restroom Cleaning & Sanitizing
- Vacuuming & Floor Mopping
- Dusting & Surface Wiping
- High-Touch Disinfection
- Carpet Cleaning (specialty)
- Window Washing (specialty)
- Post-Construction Cleanup (specialty)

## Areas served

Downtown Core, Beltline, Eau Claire, East Village, Mission,
Kensington / Hillhurst, Inglewood, Chinatown, Bridgeland — Calgary, AB.
Service area is expanding.

- Insured & bonded
- Flexible after-hours scheduling
- Consistent crew, consistent quality
